name: same100-oof-source-li-preservation-discrepancy
status: Frozen read-only audit before calculating per-frame source/final li; no model fit, map change, native rescoring or evaluation-tail use
question: Did the fixed nine-a input-only source-li compensation actually preserve the source map's scorer-native li on the OOF100 full-normal diagnostic, and are any discrepancies concentrated in a few frames?
method: For each exact frozen OOF100 TRAIN shot/frame, read only input grid_R/grid_Z, never EFIT truth. For each saved float32 source and full-normal map separately, use the byte-pinned scorer LCFS extractor at fixed DIII-D sign and scorer derive.internal_inductance with that map's OWN extracted contour. Abort on missing/nonfinite li, filename/frame/hash mismatch. Record the signed and absolute final-minus-source li distribution, share of squared discrepancy in top1% and top10% frames, per-shot summaries and top20 frame identities. Quote the already measured native true-li R2 values only as context; this audit does not implement a score or reread labels.
interpretation: A material source-to-final li difference means the discrete nine-a compensation did not meet its input-only target on this pilot; identify concentration but do not tune the grid or propose a continuous optimizer until a separate review. A tiny discrepancy with degraded native true-li R2 would instead point to a scorer-path or comparison mismatch. Either outcome is a mechanism result, not a deployable top-three candidate.
scope_limit: Only the pinned first100 original-TRAIN OOF shots and 21,667 frames. No gate200, original evaluation tail70, public input or external labels; no new base/correction fit, score pass or upload.
